summary: Weekly significance recomputation over the 627 counted recommendations. Per-rater scores were stored on the last 41 records that lacked them (32 copied from the original rater file, 9 scored by two fresh blind AI raters, none needing a third rater), so every counted record now carries them. Weighted share in effect 18.0 percent (unweighted 18.2), weighted progress 30.2 (unweighted 30.1), centered band 17.7 to 18.2 on 627 records, rater agreement (quadratic-weighted kappa) reach 0.82, magnitude 0.86, breadth 0.85, fiscal 0.89, composite 0.91 on 627 records; stored scores and weights unchanged.
title: Significance recomputation: rater score backfill complete, weighted share 18.0 percent
